d116ad95-2f32-4fd0-82b0-4ca9cb9dc8bd.title: Feature: BOPS Same-Day Store Fulfillment Flow (MCOM Site & App)
d116ad95-2f32-4fd0-82b0-4ca9cb9dc8bd.chunk_text:
[ENTITY: FEATURE SPECIFICATION & QA INTELLIGENCE]
Feature Name: BOPS Same-Day Store Fulfillment Flow
Platform Target: MCOM Site & App
Expected Behavior & Business Requirements:
Customer chooses 'Pick Up In Store', selects store by zip (e.g. 22102), and completes checkout. Reservation ID is generated, and status moves from RESERVED -> SHPSHPD once store fulfills.
Potential Issues Faced & Edge Cases to Test:
Inventory mismatch between warehouse and physical store can cause cancellation; reservationId wrapper response missing in order mods payload if order is STH.
Things to Observe & Acceptance Criteria (AC):
Check that reservation ID is non-empty; verify SHPSHPD status update event completes with 200 HTTP response code; inspect store hours in confirmation email.
Visual Assets / Reference Screenshot: https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1555421689-491a97ff2040?w=800&auto=format&fit=crop&q=60
Video Demo / Recording Walkthrough: https://www.w3schools.com/html/mov_bbb.mp4
Keywords: feature specification BOPS Same-Day Store Fulfillment Flow MCOM Site & App expected behavior edge cases visual assets

ae0ffc56-146a-4f50-a8b0-693e9e1120b7.title: Feature: Star Money Loyalty Rewards Redemption (MCOM Site & App)
ae0ffc56-146a-4f50-a8b0-693e9e1120b7.chunk_text:
[ENTITY: FEATURE SPECIFICATION & QA INTELLIGENCE]
Feature Name: Star Money Loyalty Rewards Redemption
Platform Target: MCOM Site & App
Expected Behavior & Business Requirements:
Eligible Macy's Cardholders earn reward dollars on purchases. During checkout, available Star Money balance appears automatically and can be applied in $10 increments.
Potential Issues Faced & Edge Cases to Test:
If loyalty card number format is invalid or expired, rewards fail to load; partial refunds may cause temporary lock on reward dollars.
Things to Observe & Acceptance Criteria (AC):
Verify rewards balance reduces by chosen redemption amount; verify order total adjusts correctly with zero tax discrepancy.
Visual Assets / Reference Screenshot: https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1556742049-0a67c5574f73?w=800&auto=format&fit=crop&q=60
Video Demo / Recording Walkthrough: https://www.w3schools.com/html/mov_bbb.mp4

[ENTITY: FEATURE SPECIFICATION & QA INTELLIGENCE]
Feature Name: M-Money / B-Money Customer Account Funding
Platform Target: All Platforms (MCOM & BCOM)
Expected Behavior & Business Requirements:
Automated provisioning of gift card funding into target customer account across environments (e.g. mcom-131, mcom-170, bcom-131). Up to 4 cards funded with $30 each in under 5 seconds.
Potential Issues Faced & Edge Cases to Test:
Account must exist in the target environment database; corporate VPN required to access internal loyalty automation endpoint.
Things to Observe & Acceptance Criteria (AC):
Check Postman response wrapper for status='SUCCESS'; verify balance reflects in customer profile wallet immediately.
Visual Assets / Reference Screenshot: https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1559526324-4b87b5e36e44?w=800&auto=format&fit=crop&q=60
Video Demo / Recording Walkthrough: https://www.w3schools.com/html/mov_bbb.mp4
